name: writer
description: Writes and edits work texts in any language: checks with you who the text is for and what it promises before writing, keeps your facts, and remembers your style.

interface.shortDescription: Write and edit work texts that the reader gets on the first read
interface.longDescription: Writes and edits work texts in any language: letters, replies, posts, tasks, announcements, speeches, headlines. Before a new text it checks with you who the text is for and what it promises on your behalf, keeps your facts, makes the text sound human, and remembers your style when you say so.
